verdict.rationale: Slate is a coding agent sold with Slate credits, so issuing scoped API credentials for automated or agent use is a fair question for this product type. The evidence documents only per-action tool permissions (allow/ask/deny patterns), which is an adjacent control and not credential issuance. No API keys, tokens, or scoping of credentials are documented, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
